sources.title: ChudGPT — Custom Experimental AI Models
sources.snippet: ChudGPT is an independent experimental AI project developed and maintained by Astra / ASTRA228b. The models documented on this site—including Public, Pro, Plus, Code, Ultimate, Buggy, Mega, and archived checkpoints—belong to this project's custom model ecosystem.

sources.title: Astra / ASTRA228b — Developer, Gorilla Tag Modder & ChudGPT Creator
sources.snippet: Building tiny AI models because why not? Astra is the creator and maintainer behind the independent ChudGPT project represented by this website. ChudGPT-Public V20 is a custom 20,999,184-parameter decoder-only CUDA language model.

sources.title: GitHub - ASTRA228b/ChudGPT-Public: ChudGPT Public Repo. (AI)
sources.snippet: ChudGPT-Public is a separate 21M-class conversational transformer designed to be trained locally and published as a self-contained Hugging Face model. It does not modify or share checkpoints with Buggy, Ultimate, Plus, Pro, Code, or Mega.
